#### `src/lib/schema.ts`

```ts
import { getAbsoluteLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { sameAs } from "../data/links";
import { tagCopy, tagIds, type TagId } from "../data/tags";
import { getCopy, locales, type Locale } from "../i18n";
import {
  blogPath,
  postPath,
  tagPath,
  type Post,
  type TagSummary,
} from "./blog";

type Node = Record<string, unknown>;

const tagLabel = (id: TagId, locale: Locale) => tagCopy(id, locale).label;

const siteUrl = (site: URL | undefined) =>
  (site ?? new URL("https://clementbresson.com")).origin + "/";

export const personId = (site: URL | undefined) => `${siteUrl(site)}#person`;
export const websiteId = (site: URL | undefined) => `${siteUrl(site)}#website`;

export function personNode(
  site: URL | undefined,
  locale: Locale,
  portraitUrl: string,
): Node {
  const t = getCopy(locale);
  return {
    "@type": "Person",
    "@id": personId(site),
    name: t.name,
    url: siteUrl(site),
    image: { "@type": "ImageObject", url: portraitUrl },
    jobTitle: t.title,
    description: t.p1,
    alumniOf: { "@type": "CollegeOrUniversity", name: "ESSEC Business School" },
    knowsLanguage: locales.map((l) => getCopy(l).htmlLang),
    knowsAbout: tagIds
      .filter((id) => id !== "site")
      .map((id) => tagLabel(id, locale)),
    sameAs,
  };
}

export function websiteNode(site: URL | undefined, locale: Locale): Node {
  const t = getCopy(locale);
  return {
    "@type": "WebSite",
    "@id": websiteId(site),
    url: siteUrl(site),
    name: t.name,
    inLanguage: locales.map((l) => getCopy(l).htmlLang),
    publisher: { "@id": personId(site) },
  };
}

export function breadcrumbNode(items: { name: string; url: string }[]): Node {
  return {
    "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
    itemListElement: items.map((item, i) => ({
      "@type": "ListItem",
      position: i + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: item.url,
    })),
  };
}

export function blogNode(
  site: URL | undefined,
  locale: Locale,
  posts: Post[],
): Node {
  const t = getCopy(locale);
  const url = getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath);
  return {
    "@type": "Blog",
    "@id": `${url}#blog`,
    url,
    name: t.blog.metaTitle,
    description: t.blog.description,
    inLanguage: t.htmlLang,
    author: { "@id": personId(site) },
    publisher: { "@id": personId(site) },
    isPartOf: { "@id": websiteId(site) },
    blogPost: posts.map((p) => ({
      "@type": "BlogPosting",
      "@id": getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(p.slug)),
      headline: p.data.title,
      url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(p.slug)),
      datePublished: p.data.pubDate.toISOString(),
    })),
  };
}

export function tagPageNode(locale: Locale, tag: TagSummary): Node {
  const t = getCopy(locale);
  const url = getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, tagPath(tag.id));
  return {
    "@type": "CollectionPage",
    "@id": url,
    url,
    name: `${tag.label} — ${t.blog.metaTitle}`,
    description: tag.description,
    inLanguage: t.htmlLang,
    isPartOf: { "@id": `${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath)}#blog` },
    about: { "@type": "Thing", name: tag.label },
    hasPart: tag.posts.map((p) => ({
      "@type": "BlogPosting",
      "@id": getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(p.slug)),
      headline: p.data.title,
      url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(p.slug)),
      datePublished: p.data.pubDate.toISOString(),
    })),
  };
}

export function blogPostingNode(
  site: URL | undefined,
  post: Post,
  opts: {
    coverUrl?: string;
    fallbackImageUrl: string;
    wordCount: number;
    readingMinutes: number;
  },
): Node {
  const t = getCopy(post.locale);
  const url = getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(post.locale, postPath(post.slug));
  const blogUrl = getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(post.locale, blogPath);
  return {
    "@type": "BlogPosting",
    "@id": url,
    url,
    mainEntityOfPage: { "@type": "WebPage", "@id": url },
    headline: post.data.title,
    description: post.data.description,
    image: [opts.coverUrl ?? opts.fallbackImageUrl],
    datePublished: post.data.pubDate.toISOString(),
    dateModified: (post.data.updatedDate ?? post.data.pubDate).toISOString(),
    author: { "@id": personId(site) },
    publisher: { "@id": personId(site) },
    isPartOf: { "@id": `${blogUrl}#blog` },
    inLanguage: t.htmlLang,
    ...(post.data.tags.length
      ? {
          keywords: post.data.tags
            .map((id) => tagLabel(id, post.locale))
            .join(", "),
        }
      : {}),
    ...(post.data.tags.length
      ? { articleSection: tagLabel(post.data.tags[0], post.locale) }
      : {}),
    wordCount: opts.wordCount,
    timeRequired: `PT${opts.readingMinutes}M`,
    isAccessibleForFree: true,
    ...(post.data.linkedin ? { sameAs: [post.data.linkedin] } : {}),
    ...(post.data.sources.length
      ? {
          citation: post.data.sources.map((s) => ({
            "@type": "CreativeWork",
            name: s.title,
            ...(s.author
              ? { author: { "@type": "Person", name: s.author } }
              : {}),
            ...(s.year ? { datePublished: String(s.year) } : {}),
            ...(s.url ? { url: s.url } : {}),
          })),
        }
      : {}),
  };
}

export function graph(nodes: Node[]): Node {
  return { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@graph": nodes };
}
```

#### `src/lib/feed.ts`

```ts
import rss from "@astrojs/rss";
import { getAbsoluteLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { tagCopy } from "../data/tags";
import { getCopy, type Locale } from "../i18n";
import { blogPath, fileUrl, getPosts, postPath } from "./blog";

export async function buildFeed(locale: Locale): Promise<Response> {
  const t = getCopy(locale);
  const posts = await getPosts(locale);
  return rss({
    title: t.blog.metaTitle,
    description: t.blog.description,
    site: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath),
    items: posts.map((post) => ({
      title: post.data.title,
      description: post.data.description,
      pubDate: post.data.pubDate,
      link: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(post.slug)),
      categories: post.data.tags.map((id) => tagCopy(id, locale).label),
    })),
    xmlns: { atom: "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" },
    customData: `<language>${t.htmlLang}</language><atom:link href="${fileUrl(locale, "rss.xml")}" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/>`,
  });
}
```

#### `src/lib/llms.ts`

```ts
import { getAbsoluteLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { tagCopy } from "../data/tags";
import { getCopy, locales, type Locale } from "../i18n";
import {
  blogPath,
  fileUrl,
  getPosts,
  getTags,
  postPath,
  tagPath,
  type Post,
} from "./blog";

const langName: Record<Locale, string> = { en: "English", fr: "Français" };

function header(): string[] {
  const en = getCopy("en");
  const fr = getCopy("fr");
  return [
    `# ${en.name}`,
    "",
    `> ${en.title}. ${en.p1}`,
    "",
    `${en.p2} ${en.p3}`,
    "",
    "The site is bilingual. English pages live at the root, French pages under /fr/. Every article exists in both languages at the same slug.",
    "",
    "## Pages",
    "",
    `- [${en.name} (${langName.en})](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl("en")}): ${en.title}`,
    `- [${fr.name} (${langName.fr})](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl("fr")}): ${fr.title}`,
    `- [Blog (${langName.en})](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl("en", blogPath)}): ${en.blog.description}`,
    `- [Blog (${langName.fr})](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl("fr", blogPath)}): ${fr.blog.description}`,
    "",
  ];
}

async function topics(): Promise<string[]> {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const l of locales) {
    const tags = await getTags(l);
    if (!tags.length) continue;
    out.push(
      `## Topics (${langName[l]})`,
      "",
      ...tags.map(
        (tag) =>
          `- [${tag.label}](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(l, tagPath(tag.id))}): ${tag.description}`,
      ),
      "",
    );
  }
  return out;
}

function feeds(): string[] {
  return [
    "## Feeds",
    "",
    ...locales.map((l) => `- [RSS (${langName[l]})](${fileUrl(l, "rss.xml")})`),
    `- [Sitemap](${fileUrl("en", "sitemap-index.xml")})`,
    "",
  ];
}

const postLine = (p: Post) =>
  `- [${p.data.title}](${getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(p.locale, postPath(p.slug))}): ${p.data.description}`;

export async function llmsTxt(): Promise<string> {
  const out = header();
  for (const l of locales) {
    const posts = await getPosts(l);
    if (!posts.length) continue;
    out.push(`## Blog (${langName[l]})`, "", ...posts.map(postLine), "");
  }
  out.push(...(await topics()), ...feeds());
  return out.join("\n");
}

export async function llmsFullTxt(): Promise<string> {
  const out = header();
  for (const l of locales) {
    const posts = await getPosts(l);
    if (!posts.length) continue;
    out.push(`## Blog (${langName[l]})`, "");
    for (const p of posts) {
      const url = getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(l, postPath(p.slug));
      const modified = p.data.updatedDate ?? p.data.pubDate;
      out.push(
        `### ${p.data.title}`,
        "",
        `- URL: ${url}`,
        `- Language: ${getCopy(l).htmlLang}`,
        `- Published: ${p.data.pubDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
        `- Updated: ${modified.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
        ...(p.data.tags.length
          ? [
              `- Topics: ${p.data.tags.map((id) => tagCopy(id, l).label).join(", ")}`,
            ]
          : []),
        "",
        p.data.description,
        "",
        (p.body ?? "").trim(),
        "",
        "---",
        "",
      );
    }
  }
  out.push(...feeds());
  return out.join("\n");
}
```

```astro
<html lang={t.htmlLang}>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <meta name="generator" content={Astro.generator} />
    <title>{title}</title>
    <meta name="description" content={description} />
    <meta name="author" content={t.name} />
    {noindex ? (
      <meta name="robots" content="noindex" />
    ) : (
      <>
        <link rel="canonical" href={canonical} />
        {alternates.map((a) => (
          <link rel="alternate" hreflang={a.locale} href={a.href} />
        ))}
        <link
          rel="alternate"
          hreflang="x-default"
          href={getAbsoluteLocaleUrl("en", path)}
        />
      </>
    )}
    <link
      rel="alternate"
      type="application/rss+xml"
      title={t.blog.metaTitle}
      href={rssHref}
    />
    <link rel="sitemap" href="/sitemap-index.xml" />
    <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml" />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff" />

    <meta property="og:type" content={ogType} />
    <meta property="og:site_name" content={t.name} />
    <meta property="og:title" content={title} />
    <meta property="og:description" content={description} />
    <meta property="og:url" content={canonical} />
    <meta property="og:image" content={ogImageUrl} />
    <meta
      property="og:image:width"
      content={String(ogImage.attributes.width)}
    />
    <meta
      property="og:image:height"
      content={String(ogImage.attributes.height)}
    />
    <meta property="og:image:alt" content={ogImageAlt} />
    <meta property="og:locale" content={t.ogLocale} />
    {locales
      .filter((l) => l !== locale)
      .map((l) => (
        <meta property="og:locale:alternate" content={getCopy(l).ogLocale} />
      ))}
    {article && (
      <>
        <meta property="article:author" content={t.name} />
        <meta
          property="article:published_time"
          content={article.published.toISOString()}
        />
        {article.modified && (
          <meta
            property="article:modified_time"
            content={article.modified.toISOString()}
          />
        )}
        {article.section && (
          <meta property="article:section" content={article.section} />
        )}
        {article.tags?.map((tag) => (
          <meta property="article:tag" content={tag} />
        ))}
      </>
    )}
    <meta
      name="twitter:card"
      content={ogSource ? "summary_large_image" : "summary"}
    />
    <meta name="twitter:title" content={title} />
    <meta name="twitter:description" content={description} />
    <meta name="twitter:image" content={ogImageUrl} />
    <meta name="twitter:image:alt" content={ogImageAlt} />

    <script
      type="application/ld+json"
      set:html={JSON.stringify(jsonLd).replace(/</g, "\\u003c")}
    ></script>
    <Font cssVariable="--font-newsreader" preload />
    <Font cssVariable="--font-geist" preload />
  </head>
  <body>
    <slot />
  </body>
</html>
```

```astro
---
import { getImage } from "astro:assets";
import { getAbsoluteLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import portrait from "../assets/portrait.png";
import { tagCopy } from "../data/tags";
import { getCopy } from "../i18n";
import Base from "../layouts/Base.astro";
import {
  blogPath,
  postPath,
  readingMinutes,
  wordCount,
  type Post,
} from "../lib/blog";
import { blogPostingNode, breadcrumbNode } from "../lib/schema";
import BlogPost from "./BlogPost.astro";

interface Props {
  post: Post;
}

const { post } = Astro.props;
const { locale, data } = post;
const t = getCopy(locale);

const coverUrl = data.cover
  ? new URL(
      (
        await getImage({
          src: data.cover,
          width: 1200,
          format: "jpg",
          quality: 82,
        })
      ).src,
      Astro.site,
    ).href
  : undefined;

const fallbackImageUrl = new URL(
  (await getImage({ src: portrait, width: 1200, format: "jpg", quality: 82 }))
    .src,
  Astro.site,
).href;

const schema = [
  blogPostingNode(Astro.site, post, {
    coverUrl,
    fallbackImageUrl,
    wordCount: wordCount(post.body),
    readingMinutes: readingMinutes(post.body),
  }),
  breadcrumbNode([
    { name: t.name, url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale) },
    { name: t.blog.title, url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath) },
    {
      name: data.title,
      url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(post.slug)),
    },
  ]),
];
---

<Base
  locale={locale}
  path={postPath(post.slug)}
  title={data.title}
  description={data.description}
  ogType="article"
  ogImage={
    data.cover
      ? { src: data.cover, alt: data.coverAlt ?? data.title }
      : undefined
  }
  article={{
    published: data.pubDate,
    modified: data.updatedDate,
    tags: data.tags.map((id) => tagCopy(id, locale).label),
    section: data.tags[0] ? tagCopy(data.tags[0], locale).label : undefined,
  }}
  schema={schema}
>
  <BlogPost post={post} />
</Base>
```

```astro
// BlogIndex before Base: the import order decides the order of their styles in the page.
import BlogIndex from "./BlogIndex.astro";
import { getAbsoluteLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { getCopy, type Locale } from "../i18n";
import Base from "../layouts/Base.astro";
import {
  blogPath,
  getPosts,
  getTags,
  tagPath,
  type TagSummary,
} from "../lib/blog";
import { blogNode, breadcrumbNode, tagPageNode } from "../lib/schema";

interface Props {
  locale: Locale;
  tag?: TagSummary;
}

const { locale, tag } = Astro.props;
const t = getCopy(locale);
const tags = await getTags(locale);
const posts = tag ? tag.posts : await getPosts(locale);
const crumbs = [
  { name: t.name, url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale) },
  { name: t.blog.title, url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath) },
];
const schema = tag
  ? [
      tagPageNode(locale, tag),
      breadcrumbNode([
        ...crumbs,
        { name: tag.label, url: getAbsoluteLocaleUrl(locale, tagPath(tag.id)) },
      ]),
    ]
  : [blogNode(Astro.site, locale, posts), breadcrumbNode(crumbs)];
---

<Base
  locale={locale}
  path={tag ? tagPath(tag.id) : blogPath}
  title={tag ? `${tag.label} — ${t.blog.metaTitle}` : t.blog.metaTitle}
  description={tag ? tag.description : t.blog.description}
  schema={schema}
>
  <BlogIndex locale={locale} posts={posts} tags={tags} tag={tag} />
</Base>
```

#### `src/components/BlogPost.astro`

```astro
---
import { Image } from "astro:assets";
import { render } from "astro:content";
import { getRelativeLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { tagCopy } from "../data/tags";
import { getCopy } from "../i18n";
import {
  blogPath,
  formatDate,
  getRelated,
  postPath,
  readingMinutes,
  type Post,
} from "../lib/blog";
import LangToggle from "./LangToggle.astro";
import TagList from "./TagList.astro";

interface Props {
  post: Post;
}

const { post } = Astro.props;
const { locale, data } = post;
const t = getCopy(locale);
const { Content } = await render(post);
const iso = (d: Date) => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const tags = data.tags.map((id) => ({ id, label: tagCopy(id, locale).label }));
const minutes = readingMinutes(post.body);
const related = await getRelated(post);
---

<LangToggle
  current={locale}
  label={t.langSwitchLabel}
  path={postPath(post.slug)}
/>

<main class="page">
  <article>
    <header class="head">
      <nav class="crumbs rise" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale)}>{t.name}</a>
        <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
        <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath)}>{t.blog.title}</a>
      </nav>
      <h1 class="heading rise" style="--delay: 80ms">
        {data.title}
      </h1>
      <p class="meta rise" style="--delay: 160ms">
        <span>
          <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale)} rel="author">
            {t.name}
          </a>
          {" · "}
        </span>
        <span>
          {t.blog.published}{" "}
          <time datetime={iso(data.pubDate)}>
            {formatDate(data.pubDate, locale)}
          </time>
        </span>
        {data.updatedDate && (
          <span>
            {" · "}
            {t.blog.updated}{" "}
            <time datetime={iso(data.updatedDate)}>
              {formatDate(data.updatedDate, locale)}
            </time>
          </span>
        )}
        <span>
          {" · "}
          {minutes} {t.blog.minRead}
        </span>
      </p>
      {data.cover && (
        <Image
          class="cover rise"
          style="--delay: 240ms"
          src={data.cover}
          alt={data.coverAlt ?? ""}
          widths={[640, 1280]}
          sizes="(max-width: 680px) 100vw, 640px"
          format="webp"
          quality={82}
          loading="eager"
          fetchpriority="high"
        />
      )}
    </header>

    <div class="prose rise" style="--delay: 320ms">
      <Content />
    </div>

    {data.sources.length > 0 && (
      <section
        class="sources rise"
        style="--delay: 360ms"
        aria-labelledby="sources-title"
      >
        <h2 id="sources-title">{t.blog.sources}</h2>
        <ul>
          {data.sources.map((s) => (
            <li>
              {s.author && <span class="author">{s.author}, </span>}
              {s.url ? (
                <a href={s.url} rel="noopener">
                  {s.title}
                </a>
              ) : (
                <cite>{s.title}</cite>
              )}
              {s.year && <span class="year"> ({s.year})</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>
    )}

    <footer class="article-foot rise" style="--delay: 400ms">
      {tags.length > 0 && (
        <TagList locale={locale} tags={tags} label={t.blog.topics} />
      )}
      {data.linkedin && (
        <p class="origin">
          <a href={data.linkedin} rel="noopener">
            {t.blog.originallyOnLinkedIn}
          </a>
        </p>
      )}
    </footer>
  </article>

  {related.length > 0 && (
    <aside
      class="related rise"
      style="--delay: 440ms"
      aria-labelledby="related-title"
    >
      <h2 id="related-title">{t.blog.related}</h2>
      <ul>
        {related.map((r) => (
          <li>
            <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(r.slug))}>
              <span class="related-title">{r.data.title}</span>
              <span class="related-desc">{r.data.description}</span>
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </aside>
  )}

  <footer class="foot rise" style="--delay: 480ms">
    <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath)}>← {t.blog.backToBlog}</a>
  </footer>
</main>

<style>
  .page {
    max-width: 640px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 96px 24px 80px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .crumbs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    font: 400 14.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .crumbs a,
  .foot a,
  .origin a {
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    padding-bottom: 3px;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .crumbs a:hover,
  .foot a:hover,
  .origin a:hover {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-bottom-color: currentColor;
  }

  .heading {
    margin: 28px 0 0;
    font: 400 40px/1.15 var(--font-newsreader);
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    color: var(--color-ink);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .meta {
    margin: 16px 0 0;
    font: 400 13.5px/1.6 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .meta a {
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .meta a:hover {
    color: var(--color-ink);
  }

  .cover {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin: 40px 0 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  .prose {
    margin-top: 48px;
  }

  .sources {
    margin-top: 56px;
    padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  }

  .sources h2,
  .related h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-geist);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .sources ul {
    margin: 16px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    font: 400 14.5px/1.6 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-body);
  }

  .sources li + li {
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .sources a {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-color: var(--color-inactive);
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }

  .sources a:hover {
    text-decoration-color: currentColor;
  }

  .sources cite {
    font-style: italic;
  }

  .sources .year {
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .article-foot {
    margin-top: 48px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .origin {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 13.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
  }

  .related {
    margin-top: 72px;
    padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  }

  .related ul {
    margin: 20px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .related li + li {
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .related a {
    display: block;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
  }

  .related-title {
    display: block;
    font: 400 21px/1.3 var(--font-newsreader);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--color-ink);
    text-wrap: balance;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .related a:hover .related-title {
    color: var(--color-hover);
  }

  .related-desc {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 5px;
    font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .foot {
    margin-top: 56px;
    font: 400 14.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
  }

  @media (max-width: 400px) {

      font-size: 34px;

</style>
```

#### `src/components/BlogIndex.astro`

```astro
---
import { getRelativeLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { getCopy, type Locale } from "../i18n";
import {
  blogPath,
  filePath,
  formatDate,
  postPath,
  tagPath,
  type Post,
  type TagSummary,
} from "../lib/blog";
import LangToggle from "./LangToggle.astro";
import TagList from "./TagList.astro";

interface Props {
  locale: Locale;
  posts: Post[];
  tags: TagSummary[];
  tag?: TagSummary;
}

const { locale, posts, tags, tag } = Astro.props;
const t = getCopy(locale);
const path = tag ? tagPath(tag.id) : blogPath;
const topics = tags.map((x) => ({
  id: x.id,
  label: x.label,
  count: x.posts.length,
}));
---

<LangToggle current={locale} label={t.langSwitchLabel} path={path} />

<main class="page">
  <header class="head">
    <nav class="crumbs rise" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale)}>{t.name}</a>
      {tag && (
        <>
          <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
          <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath)}>{t.blog.title}</a>
        </>
      )}
    </nav>
    <h1 class="heading rise" style="--delay: 80ms">
      {tag ? tag.label : t.blog.title}
    </h1>
    <p class="intro rise" style="--delay: 160ms">
      {tag ? tag.description : t.blog.description}
    </p>
    {!tag && tags.length > 0 && (
      <div class="topics rise" style="--delay: 200ms">
        <TagList locale={locale} tags={topics} label={t.blog.topics} />
      </div>
    )}
  </header>

  {posts.length === 0 ? (
    <p class="empty rise" style="--delay: 240ms">
      {t.blog.empty}
    </p>
  ) : (
    <ol class="list rise" style="--delay: 240ms">
      {posts.map((post) => (
        <li class="item">
          <a
            class="item-link"
            href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, postPath(post.slug))}
          >
            <time
              class="date"
              datetime={post.data.pubDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}
            >
              {formatDate(post.data.pubDate, locale)}
            </time>
            <h2 class="item-title">{post.data.title}</h2>
            <p class="item-desc">{post.data.description}</p>
          </a>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  )}

  <footer class="foot rise" style="--delay: 320ms">
    {tag ? (
      <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, blogPath)}>← {t.blog.backToBlog}</a>
    ) : (
      <a href={filePath(locale, "rss.xml")}>{t.blog.rss}</a>
    )}
  </footer>
</main>

<style>
  .page {
    max-width: 620px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 96px 24px 80px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .crumbs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    font: 400 14.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .crumbs a {
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    padding-bottom: 3px;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .crumbs a:hover {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-bottom-color: currentColor;
  }

  .heading {
    margin: 28px 0 0;
    font: 400 44px/1.1 var(--font-newsreader);
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    color: var(--color-ink);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .intro {
    margin: 16px 0 0;
    font: 400 15.5px/1.7 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .topics {
    margin-top: 28px;
  }

  .empty {
    margin: 56px 0 0;
    font: 400 15.5px/1.7 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-muted);
  }

  .list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 56px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .item + .item {
    margin-top: 40px;
  }

  .item-link {
    display: block;

    color: inherit;
  }

  .date {
    display: block;
    font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  .item-title {
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    font: 400 26px/1.25 var(--font-newsreader);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--color-ink);
    text-wrap: balance;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .item-link:hover .item-title {
    color: var(--color-hover);
  }

  .item-desc {
    margin: 8px 0 0;
    font: 400 15px/1.65 var(--font-geist);
    color: var(--color-body);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }

  .foot {
    margin-top: 72px;
    font: 400 13.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
  }

  .foot a {
```

```astro
---
import { getRelativeLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import type { TagId } from "../data/tags";
import type { Locale } from "../i18n";
import { tagPath } from "../lib/blog";

interface Props {
  locale: Locale;
  tags: { id: TagId; label: string; count?: number }[];
  label?: string;
  current?: TagId;
  class?: string;
  style?: string;
}

const { locale, tags, label, current, class: className, style } = Astro.props;
---

<nav class:list={["tags", className]} aria-label={label} style={style}>
  {label && <span class="label">{label}</span>}
  <ul>
    {tags.map((tag) => (
      <li>
        {tag.id === current ? (
          <span aria-current="page">{tag.label}</span>
        ) : (
          <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(locale, tagPath(tag.id))}>
            {tag.label}
            {tag.count !== undefined && <span class="count">{tag.count}</span>}
          </a>
        )}
      </li>
    ))}
  </ul>
</nav>

<style>
  .tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px 18px;
    font: 400 13.5px/1 var(--font-geist);
  }

  .label {
    color: var(--color-inactive);
  }

  ul {
    display: contents;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  a,
  span[aria-current] {
    display: inline-block;
    padding-bottom: 3px;
    color: var(--color-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  a:hover {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-bottom-color: currentColor;
  }

  span[aria-current] {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-ink);
  }

  .count {
    margin-left: 5px;
    color: var(--color-inactive);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
</style>
```

#### `src/components/LangToggle.astro`

```astro
---
import { getRelativeLocaleUrl } from "astro:i18n";
import { locales, type Locale } from "../i18n";

interface Props {
  current: Locale;
  label: string;
  path?: string;
}

const { current, label, path = "" } = Astro.props;
---

<nav class="toggle rise" aria-label={label} style="--delay: 640ms">
  {locales.map((l) =>
    l === current ? (
      <a
        href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(l, path)}
        aria-current="page"
        hreflang={l}
        lang={l}
      >
        {l.toUpperCase()}
      </a>
    ) : (
      <a href={getRelativeLocaleUrl(l, path)} hreflang={l} lang={l}>
        {l.toUpperCase()}
      </a>
    ),
  )}
</nav>

<style>
  .toggle {
    position: absolute;
    top: 28px;
    right: 32px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    font: 400 13px/1 var(--font-geist);
  }

  .toggle a {
    padding: 4px 2px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--color-inactive);
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .toggle a:hover {
    color: var(--color-hover);
  }

  .toggle a[aria-current="page"],
  .toggle a[aria-current="page"]:hover {
    color: var(--color-ink);
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-ink);
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .toggle {
      top: 20px;
      right: 20px;
    }
  }
</style>
```

#### `src/pages/robots.txt.ts`

```ts
import type { APIRoute } from "astro";

const aiCrawlers = [
  "GPTBot",
  "OAI-SearchBot",
  "ChatGPT-User",
  "ClaudeBot",
  "Claude-SearchBot",
  "Claude-User",
  "anthropic-ai",
  "PerplexityBot",
  "Perplexity-User",
  "Google-Extended",
  "Applebot-Extended",
  "Bingbot",
  "CCBot",
  "DuckAssistBot",
  "meta-externalagent",
  "Amazonbot",
  "MistralAI-User",
];

export const GET: APIRoute = ({ site }) => {
  const lines = [
    "User-agent: *",
    "Allow: /",
    "",
    ...aiCrawlers.flatMap((ua) => [`User-agent: ${ua}`, "Allow: /", ""]),
    `Sitemap: ${new URL("sitemap-index.xml", site).href}`,
    "",
  ];
  return new Response(lines.join("\n"), {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" },
  });
};
```

### Config and deploy

#### `astro.config.mjs`

```js
// @ts-check
import { defineConfig, fontProviders } from "astro/config";
import sitemap from "@astrojs/sitemap";
import { latestPostDate, postLastModified } from "./src/lib/post-dates.mjs";

const site = process.env.SITE_URL ?? "https://clementbresson.com";

const lastModified = postLastModified();
const latest = latestPostDate();
const postUrl = /^\/(?:(fr)\/)?blog\/([^/]+)\/?$/;
const listUrl = /^\/(?:fr\/)?blog\/(?:tag\/[^/]+\/?)?$/;

export default defineConfig({
  site,
  output: "static",
  trailingSlash: "ignore",
  integrations: [
    sitemap({
      i18n: { defaultLocale: "en", locales: { en: "en", fr: "fr" } },
      serialize(item) {
        const path = new URL(item.url).pathname;
        const m = path.match(postUrl);
        if (m && m[2] !== "tag") {
          const date = lastModified.get(`${m[1] ?? "en"}/${m[2]}`);
          if (date) item.lastmod = date.toISOString();
        } else if (listUrl.test(path) && latest) {
          item.lastmod = latest.toISOString();
        }
        return item;
      },
    }),
  ],
  i18n: {
    locales: ["en", "fr"],
    defaultLocale: "en",
    routing: {
      prefixDefaultLocale: false,
    },
  },
  fonts: [
    {
      provider: fontProviders.local(),
      name: "Newsreader",
      cssVariable: "--font-newsreader",
      display: "swap",
      fallbacks: ["Georgia", "Times New Roman", "serif"],
      options: {
        variants: [
          {
            src: [
              "./node_modules/@fontsource-variable/newsreader/files/newsreader-latin-standard-normal.woff2",
            ],
            weight: "200 800",
            style: "normal",
          },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      provider: fontProviders.local(),
      name: "Geist",
      cssVariable: "--font-geist",
      display: "swap",
      fallbacks: ["system-ui", "sans-serif"],
      options: {
        variants: [
          {
            src: [
              "./node_modules/@fontsource-variable/geist/files/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2",
            ],
            weight: "100 900",
            style: "normal",
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
});
```

#### `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`

```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  # Daily rebuild: publishes articles whose pubDate has arrived (04:10 UTC = early morning in Paris).
  schedule:
    - cron: "10 4 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run article:check
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
          retention-days: 1

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Cloudflare
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://clementbresson.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: deploy
```

```md
A harness is everything in an agent that is not the model.

Birgitta Böckeler (martinfowler.com, April 2026) structures it along two axes.

## Axis 1: timing

- **Guides** act before: they raise the probability that the first draft is right.
- **Sensors** act after: they let the agent correct itself.

Without sensors, the agent repeats the same mistake. Without guides, it does not know which rules to apply.

## Axis 2: mode

- **Computational**: tsc, ESLint, [dependency-cruiser](/blog/dependency-cruiser-as-a-sensor-for-ai-agents/). Deterministic, a few seconds.
- **Inferential**: a review skill, an LLM judge. Semantic, expensive, non-deterministic.

## Four boxes

Cross the two axes and you get four boxes.

Your AGENTS.md occupies only one of them: inferential guides. The least deterministic box, yet often the only one filled.

A dependency-cruiser rule wired into a hook fills another box: the agent learns it violated a boundary before you open the PR.

Placement rule: the faster a check is, the further left it belongs. Hook, pre-commit, CI, human review.

## The harnessability of a codebase

But not all of these checks are available everywhere. Strict typing gives you a sensor. [Clean module boundaries](/blog/architecture-rules-that-break-the-build/) make a structural rule possible. Without those properties, the check does not exist.

Böckeler calls this the harnessability of a codebase, and draws the conclusion that hurts: the harness is most necessary where it is hardest to build.
```

```md
Un harnais, c’est tout ce qui, dans un agent, n’est pas le modèle.

Birgitta Böckeler (martinfowler.com, avril 2026) le structure sur deux axes.

## Axe 1 : le moment

- Les **guides** agissent avant : ils augmentent la probabilité que le premier jet soit bon.
- Les **capteurs** (sensors) agissent après : ils permettent à l’agent de se corriger.

Sans capteurs, l’agent répète la même erreur. Sans guides, il ne sait pas quelles règles appliquer.

## Axe 2 : le mode

- **Computationnel** : tsc, ESLint, [dependency-cruiser](/fr/blog/dependency-cruiser-as-a-sensor-for-ai-agents/). Déterministe, quelques secondes.
- **Inférentiel** : skill de revue, juge LLM. Sémantique, cher, non déterministe.

## Quatre cases

Croisez les deux axes : cela donne quatre cases.

Votre AGENTS.md n’en occupe qu’une : les guides inférentiels. La moins déterministe, mais souvent la seule remplie.

Une règle dependency-cruiser branchée en hook remplit une autre case : l’agent apprend qu’il a violé une frontière avant que vous ouvriez la PR.

Règle de placement : plus un contrôle est rapide, plus il doit être à gauche. Hook, pre-commit, CI, relecture humaine.

## La harnessability d’une codebase

Mais tous ces contrôles ne sont pas disponibles partout. Un typage strict donne un capteur. Des [frontières de modules nettes](/fr/blog/architecture-rules-that-break-the-build/) rendent une règle structurelle possible. Sans ces propriétés, le contrôle n’existe pas.

Böckeler appelle ça la harnessability d’une codebase, et elle en tire la conclusion qui fait mal : le harnais est le plus nécessaire là où il est le plus difficile à construire.
```
